brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel will not tolerate the presence of a Turkish military force in Syria that poses a threat to Israel, Maan Wire reported. His statement reflects Israel's long-standing concerns about foreign military deployments near its borders and the potential security risks they may create.

Turkey has maintained a military presence in parts of northern Syria since 2016, conducting operations against Kurdish armed groups. Netanyahu's warning signals Israeli determination to prevent what it views as hostile military capabilities from establishing themselves in neighboring Syrian territory, a position Israel has asserted repeatedly in recent years as regional military dynamics have shifted.
title: Netanyahu warns Israel will not tolerate Turkish military force in Syria
